text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I ran a disappointing race last time,
but today is the day...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Since I have the privilege of competing against serious Umamusume,
I have to aim for victory with everything I've got too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: "Running like I did last time would be disrespectful to the other Umamusume!"
choice_data_list: I think that's a great mindset.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Right?! My running might just help fire up my fave's fighting spirit!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"The more fired up I get,
the more hyped the horse girls become...!
And then they show us how brilliantly they can shine...!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Meaning a perpetual motion machine!
A never-ending exchange of love and fan service!
Now then, let us brace ourselves and run...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I don't quite get it, but Agnes Digital
seems plenty motivated...!"
